channel.title: Morning Mail
channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: RTX Career Day 10/21
item.description: Join representatives from RTX for a Career Day in the Darrin Communications Center Great Hall on Wednesday, October 21st! Meet with the team to learn about available internship and full-time opportunities, as well as life at the company. Bring your questions to their tables from 9am to 5pm! Register in Handshake.
item.author: Students

item.title: RPI NROTC Krispy Kreme Fundraiser
item.description: Date: Monday, October 26, 2026 - Thu , October 29, 2026 (all day) - Support RPI NROTC by pre-ordering a dozen Krispy Kreme Donuts for just $12! Pre-orders are open from October 9th-16th with pickup at Union and Sage from October 26th-30th. Scan the QR code on the flyer to place your order and help support our NROTC program. Thank you for your support and enjoy a sweet treat while supporting our midshipmen!
item.author: Students

item.title: RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series – October 2026
item.description: The RPI Semiconductor CoLab Catalyst Seminar Series brings together faculty, researchers, and industry partners to share ideas, highlight collaborations, and advance semiconductor and microelectronics innovation. The seminar on October 20th, at the Albany NanoTech Complex, features Jacob Merson (RPI) and Dureseti (Chidu) Chidambarrao (IBM) in two 45-min talks and a networking break. Faculty and students are invited, registration is required, transportation is possible. Follow the links..

item.title: RPI Department of Economics Fall Seminar: Josh Ederington, Miami University
item.description: Please join us on October 16 at 2pm in Sage 5101 as the Department of Economics welcomes Dr. Josh Ederington, who will present “Foreign Competition and U.S. Facility Emissions: Margins of Adjustment”. Note that we are on a Monday schedule on 10/16.

item.title: FBI Cyberthreat Presentation - No RSVP needed!
item.description: Date: Friday, October 16th Time: 12 pm to 1 pm Location: CBIS Auditorium - Join us for a presentation by the FBI Cyber Task Force for updates to the Cyberthreat landscape and opportunities for private sector University collaboration.
item.author: Community

item.title: Faculty and Staff In-Person Workshop: Get Wise with the Owl
item.description: Date: Monday, October 19, 2026 12:00 PM - 1:00 PM - Discover how to make the most of your Meeting Owl! Whether your department already has an Owl or you’re considering one, this hands-on workshop will walk you through everything you need to know — from setup and placement to an overview of benefits and key features like 360° video, automatic speaker tracking, and pairing devices. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: Call for Survey Participants - First Generation Faculty & Staff
item.description: As we prepare for our National First-Generation Student week November 3-7, the Office of Inclusive Excellence invites you to complete this short survey if you are a faculty or staff member who identifies—or has identified—as a first-generation college graduate- (defined as someone whose parent(s)/guardian(s) did not complete a four-year college degree).

item.title: 3rd annual Finance Conference
item.description: Date: Wednesday, October 28, 2026 (all day) - RPI’s Division of Finance is excited to announce the 3rd annual Finance Conference on October 28, 2026. Come explore a curated lineup of interactive sessions designed to advance your professional skills and deepen your understanding of critical topics in higher education.

item.title: Atomic Habits: Division of Human Resources: Book Discussion Series
item.description:
This session is designed to facilitate an open discussion of Atomic Habits by James Clear. Participants will reflect on the book’s key concepts, share perspectives, and discuss practical ways to apply its principles to personal and professional growth. No matter your goals, Atomic Habits offers a proven framework for improving–every day.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
